parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH=4, MATRIX_LR=0.06, and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 hit 1.046211. While the team is exploring DEPTH=6, my results suggest that at lower depths, lower learning rates and warmup are yielding consistent gains. Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if width helps my current stable config.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 32 to 64 to test if increased model width improves the current best low-depth configuration.
